selected_repelling_endpoint_contract.parameter_phase_gauge: chi(Gamma_lambda)=0 at fixed xi, plus the differentiated selected-anchor equation
selected_repelling_endpoint_contract.parameter_shift_sensitivity: q Gamma_{xi,lambda}+q_lambda Gamma_xi=partial_theta Gamma_lambda, lambda in {a,eta}
selected_repelling_endpoint_contract.period_delay_parameter_convention: T_* is the frozen plant delay under a and eta derivatives; varying T_* would add a translated-history derivative and requires a separate strong-space delay column
selected_repelling_endpoint_contract.phase_coordinate: chi(Gamma^r(xi;a,eta))=xi for one fixed bounded full-history functional chi
selected_repelling_endpoint_contract.phase_transversality: chi(partial_xi Gamma^r)=1 and the selected anchor removes the remaining autonomous translation/reparameterization
selected_repelling_endpoint_contract.physical_a_to_scaled_nu_conversion: a=1+(1/5)nu, hence Gamma_a=5 Gamma_nu at fixed epsilon within one coordinate representation; physical and fold components are related by D S_delta and the internal fields satisfy q_fold=q_phys/delta
selected_repelling_endpoint_contract.physical_phase_space: X_phys=C([-T_*,0],R^2); under s=delta*t its fold-time pullback is X_fold=C([-Theta_*,0],R^2), with S_delta(phi)(sigma)=((phi_V(sigma/delta)-1)/delta,(2/3-phi_W(sigma/delta))/delta^2)
selected_repelling_endpoint_contract.scalar_hit_time_requirement: a scalar section may define L_+ only after a directed nonzero crossing derivative; it is not the endpoint chart
selected_repelling_endpoint_contract.selected_chart: Gamma^r:I_xi x P -> M^1_{a,eta}, with rank partial_xi Gamma^r=1
selected_repelling_endpoint_contract.selection_condition: one fixed nonlinear repelling-tail/outer-history anchor, continued coherently from a validated selected reference; invariance alone does not select a threshold
selected_repelling_endpoint_contract.strong_solution_manifold: M^1_{a,eta}=M^1_phys={phi in C^1([-T_*,0]): phi'(0)=F_phys(phi;a,eta)}; equivalently M^1_fold_{nu,eta}={Phi in C^1([-Theta_*,0]): Phi'(0)=F_fold(Phi;nu,eta)}
